Handyman Repairs & Installation in Dubai

Small jobs are easier to price together when each item has a location and a clear finish point. Send ServiceBay a room-by-room list for your Dubai home or business, such as hanging a mirror, assembling a desk, refitting a rail or securing a loose cabinet handle.

Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM · Dubai time

Key benefits

  • Small jobs grouped into one visit
  • Fixings chosen for the surface
  • Mounting positions agreed before work

Mounting, assembly and minor adjustments

For curtain rails and blinds, give the opening width, desired position and whether the brackets came with the product. For shelves or mirrors, include the size and weight shown on the packaging. Mention tiled, glass, concrete or partition surfaces so the fixing method can be assessed before an appointment.

Work you can request

  • Mirror and shelf mounting
  • Curtain rails and blinds
  • Flat-pack assembly
  • Minor fitting adjustments

Most common problems

  • A rail has come loose
  • A mirror needs a suitable fixing
  • Several small jobs need one visit

A fixture has come loose?

Stop using the affected fixture and share its position, size and intended use. Dispatch can review the task and confirm a visit window.

Call dispatch

Service photo

Why the fixing surface matters

A shelf can look level while its bracket moves under normal use. Knowing the wall material and intended load helps the technician choose a suitable fixing or propose another position.

Common component failures & expert repair solutions

ComponentWhat you may noticeHow we address it
Curtain bracketA rail droops at one end.Check the wall backing and refit with suitable anchors.
Shelf supportA shelf tilts under normal use.Match supports to the span, backing and intended load.
Furniture connectorA flat-pack joint rocks.Replace damaged hardware and check the joint sits square.
Door closerA standard internal door slams.Check mounting and closing action, then adjust or quote replacement.

Before & after service

Before the visit

List each item by room, identify the intended position and show any old holes or surface damage.

At handover

Check position, level and movement with the technician. Record any work still waiting on a part or approval.

Work by property type

Residential

For an apartment, identify drilling restrictions, lift bookings and landlord approvals. In a villa, list the floor and room for every item and identify any high mounting positions. That helps the technician arrive with suitable access equipment.

Commercial

In an office or shop, send a marked-up layout for whiteboards, rails or wall displays. Agree mounting heights with the people who use them and reserve the room or display area for the visit.

Industrial

For back offices or staff accommodation within an industrial property, list ordinary fixtures separately from warehouse equipment. Racking alterations, electrical connections, powered machinery or work at specialist heights need their own assessment.

Product models & fixing kits

Send the rail, mirror or furniture model with its assembly instructions. Identify supplied brackets and missing fittings so the technician can assess the kit.

Getting a complete job list done

Prioritise your list and send photos before booking. The team reviews materials, wall conditions and access, then confirms the visit scope. Agree any extra task before it is added on site. At handover, check positions, moving parts and cleanup together, with unfinished items recorded for follow-up.

Time, materials and extra items

Ask whether the quote covers a fixed list or an amount of technician time. Identify fixings, sealants and owner-supplied products separately. A short job needing an unusual bracket can take longer to organise than several standard assembly tasks.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about Handyman

Can I book one visit for several rooms?

Yes. Group items by room, mark the priority jobs and send one photo for each unfamiliar item. The team can confirm a realistic scope for the visit.

Can you tell what my wall is made of from a photo?

A photo can identify the finish, but the material behind it may need checking on site. Mention any drawings or information supplied by your building manager.

Do I need to mark where the mirror should go?

Share your preferred height and furniture layout. Agree the final position in person before holes are made, especially when alignment with nearby fittings matters.

Is rubbish or old furniture removal included?

List packaging, old brackets and any larger items individually. Disposal or transport should be agreed in the quote before the appointment.

What if one task needs a plumber or electrician?

Describe it on the original list so the team can allocate the appropriate trade and explain whether it can be coordinated with the handyman visit.
